jobs.title: Engineering
jobs.description: Engineering | HiBob Careers | Teamme.link Engineer your own career! Our cutting-edge HR tech software is built in house by our amazing R&D team from across the globe! Our engineers own the full development lifecycle, allowing them to see their impact immediately. Develop yourself while developing the most cutting-edge HRIS. Be you with HiBob. View our open roles Engineering Work Hard, Play Hard At HiBob, our Engineering team is all about balance—delivering top-tier innovation by day and celebrating together after hours. We believe in Work hard, Play hard, which means we put our all into building great products and then enjoy well-earned downtime with team parties, events, and plenty of laughs. From solving complex challenges to celebrating our wins, we know that having fun together is key to our strong, connected culture. Join Our Team Ido Stern SVP Engineering " At HiBob, it's not just about writing code; it's about solving real challenges with a relatable product we actually use ourselves every day. Being part of a team that values collaboration, innovation, and ownership means I get to push boundaries while staying connected to a people-first culture. Our fast-paced environment constantly evolves—both in our culture and our tech—so there’s always something exciting to build, learn, and improve. HiBob feels like more than a workplace; it’s where great ideas and great people thrive together. " Join our team Celebrating Teamwork and Innovation Our team thrives on collaboration and a shared commitment to impactful change. Every project is an opportunity to push boundaries, develop creative solutions, and make a difference. We’re proud of our talented members and grateful for the partnerships that inspire us to keep innovating. This dedication to teamwork and purpose drives us forward, and we’re excited for what lies ahead! Join Our Team Volunteering at HiBob Engineering At HiBob, volunteering is core to our engineering team’s culture. It lets us use our skills to give back, build connections, and create positive change beyond our work. Together, we strengthen our team and expand our impact, embodying HiBob’s commitment to community and collaboration. Join Our Team Hagai Levin Senior Director of Engineering " Engineering teams at HiBob work on our super-relatable SaaS product in a true CI/CD environment, and take full ownership on the development process end-to-end. We have a true people-centered culture where everyone has A LOT of personal growth opportunities. But the main reason I love it here is because people have made me feel at home from day one and I absolutely love the product and the company’s honest attempt to put people first. " Join our team Omer Reemy VP Payroll Technology " For me working at HiBob is all about the journey. Growing from a Frontend Engineer to a Director to a VP has given me so many amazing experiences and opportunities (as well as some crazy stories.
